goal: Make the contract-test pass-2 supersession repair replay later applied DROP FUNCTION/PROCEDURE/ROUTINE statements so a routine retired by a later migration is not resurrected by an older pass-2 migration.
dispatcher: Albert Hazan (session request; PR #2944 contract-test failure)
prohibited_actions: No database, preview, production, migration, claim, lease, or infrastructure write.
Do not weaken, skip or quarantine any contract test.
Do not replay a drop from a later migration that is not proven applied in the replay.
assumptions: The workflow already executes every row the script's snapshot query returns after the pass-2 migration, so emitting drop rows needs no workflow change.
A later applied re-create of the same routine name after its drop means the routine must remain present.
stop_conditions: Stop if the fix requires changing the contract-test workflow or any file outside the script, its test and the evidence pair.
